merged_morse_set_description: the unstable equilibria represented by fine nodes 2--6 and their connecting orbits
box_union_note: The plotted region is only the union of saved fine Morse-set boxes; it does not enclose connecting orbits and is not a newly computed coarse Morse set.
conley_index_note: No Conley index is assigned to the merged fiber; it must be recomputed from an index pair for the union.
